reasons.claim: 3.43 ha regeneration felling notification, status notified; no completed felling overlaps the polygon.

One eligible species, Tricholoma sudum (VU, site-bound fungus; threats include lack of continuity forest, lack of old trees and soil disturbance from forestry), is recorded 625 m from the polygon (uncertainty 10 m, 2022; latest 2023). None within 250 m.

Site-bound forest NT species number 2 within 1000 m (e.g. Sarcodon squamosus at 541 m), none within 250 m, so the 3-NT criterion is not met. Other threatened records nearby are mostly birds, butterflies or species the tool marks as not felling-relevant, and they are not eligible.
Effort is adequate (224 records within 1000 m vs county median 129.5). Near-site there are 0 records inside the polygon and 1 record on 1 day within 250 m.

uncertainties: The eligible record is 625 m away and does not show occupancy of this polygon.
Near-site effort within 250 m is thin (1 record, 1 day, county median 1.5), so the lack of nearby records is weak evidence.
